title: skills(objectstack-platform): name audit-compliance and access-policy-console among the cloud-only capability tokens (after #32011)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzh7cM8EmUX4T2CBNHX

Filing gate: ① follow-up owed by landed work. PR #32039 (card #32011) adds two cloud-loader-only tokens to `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS`, and its `Skills-docs:` line owes this edit. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #32011

## What becomes incomplete

`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L318-320 (at `main`):

> **Enterprise / cloud** — `hierarchy-security` has no open-edition provider and ships in `@objectstack/security-enterprise`, loaded through `plugins[]`; `ai-seat` and `governance` are resolved only by cloud's objectos-runtime.

Once #32039 lands, `audit-compliance` and `access-policy-console` are also resolved only by cloud's objectos-runtime, so this list is short by two.

## Ask

Add the two tokens to that sentence. Check the skill's evals for a case that enumerates the cloud-only set and extend it if one exists.

## Business reason

An AI agent authoring a stack reads this skill to decide which `requires` tokens exist and where they resolve. With the list short, it either never declares the two cloud capabilities or treats them as typos, though `defineStack` accepts them.

## Reader

The `domain:skills` seat (the file is under `skills/**`, a governed surface). Census: `git grep -n "ai-seat" skills content/docs` (releases excluded) has one hit, this line.

Dedupe: searched `"audit-compliance" OR "access-policy-console"` over issues, open and closed: 46 hits, none a skills card for this sentence (#32011 is the spec card). **New.**
